items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Meet John Lewis one time. He got a job for a spiritual woman down on foot street one time.

ctx.x: And you played for the churches? You played music in church? Yeah, yeah. I played for the church. Yeah. Yeah.

Played for the spiritual and all. Meet John Lewis one time. He got a job for a spiritual woman down on foot street one time. I'll never forget that. And we played on the outside, draw people, you know.
And you played the same old blues, huh? That's all I was doing, I played the same old blues. You don't believe it?
